review_findings.finding: brief_chars had no producer: the canonical authoring workflow and example omitted it, so the gate fell back to len(brief_summary).
review_findings.resolution: log-delegation ships as the documented writer recording len(full_brief); the workflow, example, control-plane doc, tool contracts and matrix all name it. End-to-end case 49.

review_findings.finding: diff-audit printed raw 'fatal: path ... not in origin/main' for newly added Python files.
review_findings.resolution: _blob_at reads via git_capture; an absent blob is silent. Case 50 asserts empty stderr (red before the fix).

review_findings.finding: --staged complexity read the working tree instead of the index.
review_findings.resolution: Staged mode reads the post-change side from ':path'. Case 51 stages a branchy version behind a reverted working tree (red before the fix).

review_findings.finding: check-version ran git in the caller's cwd and accepted any tag namespace.
review_findings.resolution: The lookup runs with _REPO_ROOT as cwd and filters to ^v?\d+\.\d+\.\d+$. Cases 52 and 53 (both red before the fix).

review_findings.finding: log-delegation did not reliably record the exact delegated brief length: --brief-file was optional, so omitting it silently appended a row with brief_chars: 0 at exit 0; and Path.read_text() applied universal-newline translation, so a 13-char CRLF brief was recorded as 11.
review_findings.resolution: --brief-file is required (argparse, plus an empty-value guard) and missing or unreadable input exits 2 without writing a row; the brief is read with newline='' (sys.stdin.buffer for '-') so the count is the length as supplied. Cases 54 (CRLF -> 13) and 55 (omitted input -> non-zero exit, no row), both red before the fix. Docs moved to the required-argument form.
